title: Add policy compliance metrics section to PolicyPage overview
description:
PolicyPage overview tab shows bundle cards but no aggregate compliance metrics.

**Implementation:**
- Add a metrics row above the bundle cards showing: total rules across bundles, total snapshots, last publish time
- Use existing `usePolicyBundles()` and `usePolicySnapshots()` hooks to derive counts
- Use MetricCard component from `components/ui/` for consistent styling
- Calculate: total rule count (sum of rules per bundle), active bundles count, snapshot count

**Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/PolicyPage.tsx`
definitionOfDone: Metrics row shows total rules, active bundles, snapshot count
Uses existing hook data (no new API calls)

implementationPlan.description: Update dashboard/src/pages/PolicyPage.tsx: In the overview tab (line 260-277), add a MetricCard grid row above the bundle cards grid. Import MetricCard from '../components/MetricCard' and usePolicySnapshots from '../hooks/usePolicies'. Derive from existing data: (1) Total Rules = bundles.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.rules.length, 0), (2) Active Bundles = bundles.filter(b => b.enabled !== false).length, (3) Snapshots = snapshotsData?.items?.length ?? 0, (4) Last Published = most recent bundle.publishedAt formatted with timeAgo(). Render as 4-column MetricCard grid matching HomePage pattern. Add lucide icons (Shield, Layers, History, Clock).
implementationPlan.note: Added MetricCard grid row above bundle cards in overview tab: Total Rules (sum across bundles), Active Bundles (enabled count / total), Snapshots (from usePolicySnapshots), Last Published (most recent publishedAt via timeAgo). Imported MetricCard, usePolicySnapshots, Clock icon.
